issue_title: Simplify event navigation and use horizontal upcoming-event cards
problem_statement:
Simplify event navigation and use horizontal upcoming-event cards

Owner requests: remove awkward Events dropdown, plain text navigation without pills, optional event-specific navigation logo linking to overview, upcoming events one per row with feature image left and text right (stack on mobile). Preserve the restored marketing homepage. Reuse existing event branding; no schema changes.
